name: hud_ui_panel_constructor_default_thunk
description: HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefaultThunk forwards to HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefault with null text and zero position for MSVC array construction.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a HudUiPanel or HUD text-stack source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bd100 validates pushing null text, y 0, and x 0 before calling HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefault, then returning with the constructor result.
0x4ba740 HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefault is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_panel_constructor_default.
The native panel constructor smoke calls ConstructorDefaultThunk and verifies it returns self, installs g_HudUiPanel_FTable, initializes empty text, and sets x/y to zero.
